description: Regionalización de la producción. Maíz de regadío is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). It offers the regionalization of productions at the municipal level for the crop group "Maíz en iradío", which will be valid for the period of declarations of the CAP 2015 - 2020. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Regionalization of production. Irrigated maize" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Dataset no público, Zonas sujetas a ordenación. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
